fusions.name: Folded Menu
fusions.desc: Flicks a folded menu that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Signed Writ
fusions.desc: Throws a sealed writ that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and always lands as a critical hit. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Account Settled
fusions.desc: Increases the healing you receive by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Tallied Bill
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
